The '''Wilderness''' is a [[Location]] on the [[Hub Island]]. It primarily features {{NPCSprite|Tia the Fairy}} and the Fairy Pond, as well as the [[Dark Auction]].

{{ZoneText|
|Fish in the pond.
|Visit &dTia the Fairy &fat the &dFairy Pond&f.
|Discover hidden secrets.}}

== Features ==
The '''Wilderness''' features many attractions.

=== Fairy Pond ===
The Fairy Pond is a pond located next to {{NPCSprite|Tia the Fairy}}. A [[Fishing Hotspots|Fishing Hotspot]] may sometimes appear in that pond.

=== Tavern ===
The Tavern is a building located next to the {{Zone|Dark Auction}}. It hosts several [[NPCs]]: {{NPCSprite|Shifty}}, who sells various [[Brews]]; {{NPCSprite|Lucius}}, who sells the {{Item|Shady Ring}} and its upgrades to the player for a cost; and the {{NPCSprite|Gladiator}}.

=== Dark Auction ===
{{Main|Dark Auction}}
Located in a house in the '''Wilderness''', next to the [[#Tavern|Tavern]] is the {{Zone|Dark Auction}}. Every {{Green|3}} [[SkyBlock Time|SkyBlock Days]], {{NPCSprite|Sirius}} will appear outside the house, and offer entry to the [[Dark Auction|auction]]. The player must have at least {{c|400k}} in their purse to enter. During the event, {{NPCSprite|Sirius}} will auction a set of exclusive items, which players can bid on and compete to win.

Behind the Dark Auction building, an {{Item|Ender Chest}} is located that is used to move certain items in and out of [[The Rift]].

=== Headless Horseman ===
The {{MobSprite|Headless Horseman}} can be spawned in the '''Wilderness''' using a {{Item|Horseman's Candle}}. This can only be done at [[SkyBlock Time|night]].

=== Broken Cage ===
The Broken Cage is unofficial name of the portion featuring Soul Sand, near the Tavern. It has no use, but based on {{Item|Dungeon Journal}}s, {{MobSprite|The Wither King}} was imprisoned in it, until his escape which created {{Zone|Broken Cage}} in Rift Dimension's {{zone|Wyld Woods}}.
